terminal_reason.zh: 人工要求先有真实/公开 4–6 轮 self-label logs，验证 cross-round inheritance、same-source reuse 与 lineage error enrichment；当前 repo 只有 planned pilot。
terminal_reason.en: Human review requires real/public 4–6-round self-label logs establishing cross-round inheritance, same-source reuse, and lineage error enrichment; the repo currently contains only a planned pilot.

exact_stop.zh: 当前周期 DROP；自动 reviewer 可行性判断不能升回 P0。
exact_stop.en: DROP this cycle; automated reviewer plausibility cannot promote it back to P0.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 冻结锚点评价器共适应防护

terminal_reason.zh: 独立 frozen anchors 定义方向，cross-version scoring 做 drift attribution；evaluator bias 后做 causal/neutral rubric interventions + sparse repair，Actor 同批证据保持 frozen。
terminal_reason.en: Independent frozen anchors define direction, cross-version scoring attributes drift, and evaluator bias triggers causal/neutral rubric interventions plus sparse repair while the actor stays frozen on the same evidence batch.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 external anchors、cross-version response pool、rubric atoms 与 actor-freeze rule。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze external anchors, the cross-version response pool, rubric atoms, and actor-freeze rule.

strongest_baseline.zh: frozen reward / judge ensemble / evaluator disagreement + 简单 rubric repair。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward/judge ensemble/evaluator disagreement plus simpler rubric repair.

minimum_p0.zh: 至少 3×3 actor/evaluator cross-score；先归因，再只对 evaluator-side drift 做稀疏因果 repair，独立 anchors 判真。
minimum_p0.en: At least a 3×3 actor/evaluator cross-score; attribute first, then sparsely repair only evaluator-side drift, with independent anchors defining truth.

exact_stop.zh: cross-version attribution 不优于 disagreement，或 causal+sparse repair 被简单 cell 追平，则停止相应机制。
exact_stop.en: Stop the corresponding claim if cross-version attribution does not beat disagreement or causal+sparse repair is tied by a simpler cell.

terminal_reason.zh: 与 evaluator/reward 方向重复，只保留 C-2 诊断/消融。
terminal_reason.en: Overlaps the evaluator/reward direction and remains only as a C-2 diagnostic/ablation.

terminal_reason.zh: 问题大但需要更大范围调研，本轮先搁置。
terminal_reason.en: Important problem but requires broader research; stopped for this cycle.

terminal_reason.en: Human review explicitly excludes RL/self-correction this cycle.

terminal_reason.en: Not an active P0 idea; related methods remain only as assets in the paused self-correction branch.
